faqs.q: Is there a free trial or free tier available?
faqs.a: Yes! We offer a Free Plan that is 100% free forever. It includes up to 1,000 actions every month, allowing you to test comment-to-DM replies, story automations, and quick responses completely free before deciding to upgrade. No credit card is required to sign up.

faqs.q: How does pricing per Instagram account work?
faqs.a: Every subscription tier is dedicated to a single connected Instagram Professional account. If you manage multiple Instagram accounts for different brands, businesses, or clients, each account has its own independent subscription and separate action quota.

faqs.q: What happens if I reach my plan's action limits on Free or Basic?
faqs.a: Free and Basic plans have hourly, daily, and monthly action limits. When you reach a limit, automations pause until the window resets. You can upgrade to Pro at any time for unlimited actions within Meta's official rate limits.

faqs.q: Will automating my Instagram account risk shadowbans or suspensions?
faqs.a: No. vone_dm operates exclusively through Meta's official Graph API and Messenger API for Instagram with verified webhooks and OAuth permissions. We never ask for your Instagram password, and our queuing engine strictly respects Meta's official rate limits to ensure your profile remains 100% safe.

faqs.q: What are Meta Rate Limits and how do they protect my account?
faqs.a: Meta enforces platform-level ceilings on how many actions an app can perform. Our queue engine respects those ceilings, which keeps your account compliant while maintaining steady delivery of your automations.

faqs.q: Do limits on one Instagram account affect my other connected accounts?
faqs.a: No. Meta rate limits and vone_dm quotas are strictly isolated per Instagram account. A viral reel or massive surge in comments on Account A will never exhaust the quota or slow down automation delivery on Account B.

faqs.q: What is the difference between monthly and annual billing?
faqs.a: Monthly billing renews every 30 days and yearly billing runs for 364 days from the verified payment time. Yearly billing includes a significant discount compared to paying monthly.

faqs.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
faqs.a: We accept UPI, credit cards, debit cards, net banking, and popular wallets through our payment partners.

faqs.q: Can I upgrade, downgrade, or cancel my subscription anytime?
faqs.a: Yes, absolutely. You have complete flexibility to upgrade, downgrade, or cancel your subscription at any time directly from the dashboard.

faqs.q: What exact products and values are bundled with Pro plans?
faqs.a: Pro plans bundle complimentary bonus subscriptions to industry-leading AI, video editing, 4K streaming, and music tools dispatched by VV Deals, including Adobe Express, Sony LIV, ZEE5, OpenArt, Amazon Prime, Spotify, YouTube, CapCut, and Netflix.

faqs.q: How do I claim my bonus perks?
faqs.a: Each individual full-price Pro plan subscription activated on a linked Instagram account qualifies for its respective VV Deals bonus perks. Vouchers are dispatched electronically within 24–48 hours after payment verification.

faqs.q: Is the offer valid if I use a discount coupon during checkout?
faqs.a: Coupon ineligibility: the bonus perk offer is strictly not valid if any discount coupon or promo code is applied at checkout.

faqs.q: Are the bonus products guaranteed to be delivered or in stock?
faqs.a: Bonus products are strictly subject to stock availability and are fulfilled by official third-party partners.

faqs.q: Is there a warranty on the bonus subscriptions and who handles support?
faqs.a: Third-party warranty and fulfillment are handled by VV Deals. For issues with a voucher, contact the VV Deals support page linked in your dispatch email.

faqs.q: Can I reassign an active plan to a different Instagram account?
faqs.a: Plans are bound to one Instagram account each. To move a plan, unlink the current account from Account Settings first, then link the new account.

faqs.q: Can I claim the offer multiple times if I upgrade multiple Instagram accounts?
faqs.a: Yes. Each eligible full-price Pro plan on a separate Instagram account qualifies independently.
